WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) units, SUM(f.net_amount) net, count(*) lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sold.*, COALESCE(ret.ret_units,0) ret_units FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sku) ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

WITH a AS (
 SELECT sum(f.net_amount) n, sum(f.quantity) q, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
b AS (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) n, sum(units_sold) q, sum(receipts) r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT a.n, b.n, a.q, b.q, a.r, b.r FROM a, b
